service: fal-image-service

provider:
    name: aws
    runtime: nodejs20.x
    region: ap-northeast-1
    stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
    architecture: arm64
    memorySize: 512
    timeout: 30
    logRetentionInDays: 14
    environment:
        fal_api_key: ${ssm:/fal-image-service/${self:provider.stage}/fal_api_key~true}
        ALLOWED_ORIGIN: ${ssm:/fal-image-service/${self:provider.stage}/allowed_origin}
        UPSTREAM_BASE: ${ssm:/fal-image-service/${self:provider.stage}/upstream_base, 'https://api.fal.ai'}
    httpApi:
        cors:
            allowedOrigins:
                - ${self:provider.environment.ALLOWED_ORIGIN}
            allowedMethods:
                - POST
                - OPTIONS
            allowedHeaders:
                - Content-Type
                - Authorization
            allowCredentials: false
            maxAge: 3600

functions:
    generateImage:
        handler: index.handler
        events:
            - httpApi:
                  method: POST
                  path: /api/fal/generate

package:
    patterns:
        - index.js
        - node_modules/**

plugins:
    - serverless-offline
